title: Storage Fabric identity and authority model
summary: Storage Fabric treats object identity, physical replica location, namespace path/view and route policy as separate concepts. Applications should exchange StorageRef or logical namespace paths rather than persist physical provider locators as object identity.
invariants: A physical pathname is a location, not the identity of the object.
StorageRef is stable across moves, replicas, aliases and namespace projections.
Namespace/path selection may change visibility and write semantics without changing the underlying object identity.
Storage owns storage/catalogue/namespace/materialisation semantics; it does not absorb allocator, security, source-control or queue authority.

provenance.claim: Current executable package states the object/location/path/policy separation and authority boundaries.
